objective.counting_rule: archive plus every required program, model, table, command, dependency, and inverse component

economics.authority: design and source-gate authority only; recompute from an exact complete package before native promotion

primary_algorithm.name: HORIZON-FIBER
primary_algorithm.core_claim: Recover long-range Wikipedia recurrence without transmitting source addresses by deriving retrieval identity from already decoded physical context and, only when justified, decoder-visible semantic route state.

physical_horizon.state: bounded direct-mapped record containing a verified historical key and continuation coordinate
physical_horizon.claim_boundary: The first test is representation-specific evidence on the q1/CMIX transformed stream and cannot transfer to Endpoint428 because their transformed prefixes differ.
physical_horizon.compact_crossover: Run HORIZON-DUALCLOCK on Endpoint428's exact 647,798,592-byte WRT stream with its actual 100,000,000-byte modeled-history floor. M retains the most recent occurrence; A retains the oldest surviving exact anchor. The frozen selection rule chooses from causal KT evidence without transmitted addresses.

semantic_fiber.activation: only after repeated causal route-tape identity and retained-parent residual evidence
semantic_fiber.route: decoded template name plus field key or positional identity
semantic_fiber.virtual_context: route-local decoded history advanced only when that route is active

primary_algorithm.native_probability_endpoint: pretruth integer KT calibration by bit position under a sleeping parent-preserving mixture
primary_algorithm.parent_state_rule: read parent probabilities but never snapshot, restore, fork, rejoin, or write authoritative parent state
primary_algorithm.decoder_rule: all lookup, confidence, mixture, update, reset, and collision decisions derive from the decoded prefix alone

independent_hedge.name: compact_causal_midpoint_adapter
independent_hedge.retained_evidence: The exact deep NNCP midpoint oracle saved 4726 bytes over 322978 raw bytes and was positive in every chronological third; a mature encode-only run saved 82432 bytes.
independent_hedge.negative_evidence: Output-head-only midpoint adaptation regressed by 569 bytes while the full deep update helped, so output-bias correction is retired as an explanation.
independent_hedge.rule: Do not port full closed NNCP backpropagation or checkpoint q1. Seek one bounded, decoder-reconstructible compact deep state/update realization only after the primary source gate terminalizes.

execution_graph.name: parent_independent_physical_source_census
execution_graph.promotion: Complete repeated scan, at least 313775 active bytes, treatment above alias/random/negated controls in every chronological third, positive margin in at least two distance buckets, causal verification, and no more than 524288 KiB process-tree RSS.
execution_graph.authority: authorize one retained-parent probability trace only

execution_graph.name: compact_dualclock_representation_crossover_census
execution_graph.promotion: On Endpoint428's exact full WRT stream, compare most-recent and oldest-anchor addressless exact-context continuations strictly beyond its 100,000,000-byte modeled-history floor, with causal KT self-information, repeated matched controls, and no parent probability.
execution_graph.authority: prove only that the source survives the prize-facing representation

execution_graph.name: compact_parent_probability_abi
execution_graph.promotion: Bind pretruth integer probability, truth bit, transformed coordinate, frontend digest, parent-state digest, package cost, and read-only specialist proof on a runtime-credible compact parent.
execution_graph.authority: measure retained information; no archive credit

execution_graph.name: retained_parent_horizon_atlas
execution_graph.promotion: Measured quantized gain clears the raw-scope gross gate, every chronological third is positive, controls fail, package and composite resources remain economically admissible.
execution_graph.authority: authorize one native P/K/D archive implementation

execution_graph.name: semantic_residual_addendum
execution_graph.promotion: Build the semantic route tape twice, run Fiber-CTS D/G/S/R/N, and add route-local exact recurrence only if it beats physical HORIZON on the same coordinates and parent.
execution_graph.authority: select at most one semantic residual endpoint

execution_graph.name: native_exact_archives
execution_graph.promotion: Exact encode, exact inverse, deterministic repeat, opening and distant transfer, complete package, process-tree memory, one-core runtime, 100M, then full 1G.
execution_graph.authority: only the final complete independently replayed 1G artifact may claim a Hutter result

kill_rules: Retire the frozen physical HORIZON transition if its complete source census fails a scientific gate; do not sweep key lengths, table sizes, hash functions, distances, or replacement policies.
Never transfer a source result across nonidentical transformed representations; require a fresh parent-coordinate census and probability replay.
Retire a retained-parent endpoint if its quantized gain is subscale or nonpositive in any chronological third, even if its opportunity count is large.
Retire semantic virtual-time CTS before recurrent LOOM if D fails G/S/R/N or the activated economic threshold.
Reject any mechanism requiring transmitted source addresses, match lengths, route identities, or offline dictionaries unless a separately frozen paid archive proves net value.
Do not launch another q1 full-corpus arm unless a terminal runtime adjudication shows it remains prize-eligible and it is required for a specific retained-parent proof.
Never add separately measured gains; every combination requires a fresh joint arithmetic replay and inverse.
claim_boundary: This strategy and every source census, shadow, atlas, oracle, forecast, and mixture theorem have zero Hutter score authority. No Gamma-authored full-1G score at or below 105000000 bytes has been proved.
